html:
All four of my speakers are second-hand and cost €42 altogether. I’ve had them for four or five years.

Oh, and the €42 also included a second-hand monitor, which I only retired a few days ago.


When these four old fellows finally give out, I want to get a set of Genelecs.

Why Genelec? I’ve used them in experiments, and they’re easy on the ears.
